meaning: Descriptive projection of original position residual onto predicted position, predicted rate, elapsedTime*predictedRate, and constant. Fits all displayed rows, including consumed formerheld data. Not a law, sensor/clock correction, independent forecast or causal/physical identification. Original models/source unchanged.

resolution.differenceDefinition: refined.predicted - coarse.predicted at the same sample timestamps
resolution.meaning: Difference between free-running predictions at two step resolutions; not a calibrated error bound or evidence of physical validity.
limitations: Agreement between two resolutions can miss shared numerical bias or unresolved dynamics.
Discontinuous Coulomb sign changes can invalidate smooth-law RK4 convergence assumptions.
Stiff dynamics can remain inaccurate or unstable at both resolutions.
The comparison does not alter the model, observations, initial conditions, or training ranking.
resolution.rateMeaning: Two resolutions agree within a declared screen; not a calibrated error bound.
